pick_implementation.description: Pick an authentication method to connect to your Parqet account.

pick_portfolio.title: Select Portfolios
pick_portfolio.description: Choose which portfolios to track. Each portfolio shows up as its own device under this Parqet account.

reauth_confirm.description: Your Parqet session has expired. Please re-authenticate to continue receiving portfolio data.

abort.no_portfolios: No portfolios found in your Parqet account. Create at least one portfolio at app.parqet.com, then try again.

portfolio_deleted.title: Portfolio "{portfolio_name}" removed from Parqet
portfolio_deleted.description: The portfolio "{portfolio_name}" tracked by "{entry_title}" is no longer on your Parqet account. It has been removed from this integration so refreshes stop failing. If this was unintended, restore the portfolio on Parqet, then reconfigure the integration to track it again.
